meta.name: self-customize
meta.description: Customize your own agent — add capabilities, install packages, add MCP servers, edit code or CLAUDE.md. Use when the user asks you to add a feature, install a tool, or modify how you work. For non-trivial code changes, delegate to a builder agent via create_agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义你的智能体，添加功能、安装包或修改配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要按需调整智能体的能力和行为
copy.tagline_en: Customize your agent by adding capabilities, packages, or modifying configs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to tailor your agent's abilities and behavior on demand

howto.what: 让 Claude 能按你的要求改造自己：修改它的记忆和长期指示、安装软件包、添加 MCP 服务器，或把源代码修改交给专门的 builder 代理去完成，改完由它汇报变更。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加新功能、安装工具或修改工作方式时触发，并根据变更类型选择对应流程。

say.text: 帮我把 RSS 阅读功能加进来。
say.note: Claude 会先查现成的 MCP 服务器，能加就直接加。

say.text: 帮我安装 ffmpeg 用来转写音频。
say.note: Claude 会请求管理员批准，批准后自动重建并重启。

say.text: 以后回答都先总结要点，写进记忆。
say.note: 这会直接改记忆文件，无需批准。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude customize itself: edit its memory or standing instructions, install packages or MCP servers, or delegate source-code changes to a builder agent via create_agent. It picks the workflow based on the requested change.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a feature, install a tool, or modify how Claude works. The decision tree routes to direct memory edits, package/MCP installation with admin approval, or builder-agent delegation.

say_en.text: Add RSS reading functionality for me.
say_en.note: Claude finds an MCP server or delegates to a builder.

say_en.text: Install ffmpeg so you can transcribe audio.
say_en.note: Claude requests admin approval, then rebuilds and restarts.

say_en.text: Always summarize key points before answering, write it to your memory.
say_en.note: Claude edits memory directly; no approval needed.
